public.title: Maximum Subarray
public.description: Return the largest sum of any nonempty contiguous subarray. values has 1 to 1000 integers between -10000 and 10000. An all-negative input must return its largest element rather than zero.
hints: Track the best sum ending at the current position.
A negative prefix should be discarded before extending.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Kadane recurrence either starts at the current value or extends the previous ending sum. Track the global maximum. O(n) time and O(1) space.
